findings.label: Verification evidence for THIS change not recorded in-repo
findings.detail: The tsc/lint results in plan.md describe the prior Option 2 iteration (ar.tsx useFocusEffect -> unloadUnity), not this Option B diff. A reviewer-run project-wide `tsc --noEmit` shows the AR files (unity-ar-host.tsx, ar.tsx, _layout.tsx) clean; the only errors are two pre-existing, unrelated CSS-module side-effect import errors in animated-icon.web.tsx and theme.ts, which are not in this diff. Have the coder record `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx expo lint` output for the Option B change so the gate rests on the coder's own evidence rather than a reviewer spot-check.

findings.label: Hidden surface relies on resource suspension happening Unity-side
findings.detail: The RN side keeps <UnityView> mounted and hidden (opacity:0 + translateX:100000 + pointerEvents:none), so camera/GL/ARCore stay held until the Unity-side ReactNativeBridge `hold` handler suspends them. This is correct per Option B's accepted tradeoff, but the memory/camera residency is only acceptable if the Unity handler actually runs. Verify on-device that `hold` releases the camera and suspends the session/Cesium. Out of RN scope.
